movie_title: How many organs can YOU live without? Turns out: More than we thought.
introduction: The human body is surprisingly resilient. From kidneys and spleens to chunks of your liver and even
lead_intro: Ever wondered how many organs you can live without? Test your knowledge with this quiz based on the video!

quiz.question: Which organ can you live without because your liver can compensate for its functions?
quiz.explanation: The gallbladder can be removed as the liver can still produce enough bile to aid in digestion.

quiz.question: How much of your liver can be removed and still regenerate?
quiz.explanation: Up to 70% of the liver can be removed in a healthy individual, and it will regenerate.

quiz.question: What percentage of blood can be safely taken from a person?
quiz.explanation: Up to 20% of blood can be taken safely from a person without significant harm.

quiz.question: How long does it take for bone marrow to regenerate?
quiz.explanation: Bone marrow takes around 3 weeks to regenerate after a portion of it is taken.

quiz.question: Which organs are mentioned as vital and cannot be removed?
quiz.explanation: The heart and brain are mentioned as organs that are vital and cannot be removed without dire consequences.
